projectDescription: A cross-platform 3D game engine targeting GameCube, Wii, Nintendo 3DS, Windows, Linux, macOS, and Android, with Lua scripting, a visual editor, node graph system, and native C++ addon support.
keyFeatures: Multi-platform targeting: GameCube, Wii, 3DS, Windows, Linux, macOS, Android
Lua scripting with full engine API binding
Visual node-based editor with scene hierarchy and asset pipeline
Node Graph visual programming system (Material, Shader, Procedural, and more domains)
Skeletal animation with multi-section mesh support and HumanoidAvatar retargeting
Native C++ addon system with hot-reloading in editor
Built-in networking: HTTP/HTTPS client, WebSockets, multiplayer RPC
Physics (Bullet3), NavMesh (Recast/Detour), particle systems, terrain, voxels, tilemap
Timeline/cutscene system with custom track support
Headless build mode for CI/CD pipelines and Docker
publicApiSurface: Lua script callbacks: Create(), Awake(), Start(), Stop(), Tick(deltaTime), BeginOverlap(), EndOverlap(), OnCollision()
Node types: Node3D, StaticMesh3D, SkeletalMesh3D, Camera3D, PointLight3D, DirectionalLight3D, Particle3D, Audio3D, NavMesh3D, Spline3D, Terrain3D, Voxel3D, TileMap2D
Widget types: Canvas, Button, Text, Slider, CheckBox, ComboBox, ScrollContainer, LineEdit, ProgressBar
Asset types: StaticMesh, SkeletalMesh, Material, MaterialInstance, Texture, SoundWave, Scene, SpriteAnimation, Font, Timeline
Lua Systems: Engine, Input, Audio, Renderer, Network, AssetManager, Log, Script, TimerManager, SignalBus
C++ Plugin API: PolyphasePlugin_GetDesc() entry point, PluginDesc struct, POLYPHASE_PLUGIN_API_VERSION
NodeGraph: GraphNode, GraphPin, GraphLink, GraphDomain, GraphDomainManager, GraphProcessor, REGISTER_GRAPH_NODE
